zh-CN: 生成 24 小时有效、仅能使用一次的付款链接，由朋友用自己的钱包付款上链
朋友代付仅支持公开的普通心愿卡（Solana 付款）
把链接发给朋友。链接 {time} 前有效，只能使用一次。
朋友用自己的钱包签名付款，款项直接进入官方收款地址；光栖不代发交易、不托管资金。卡片作者仍然是你。
这个代付链接不存在或已被清理。
安全提示：只向下面标注为「官方」的收款地址付款。任何人私下让你转账到其他地址都不要相信。
这是光栖官方收款地址，与网站「帮助」页公布的地址一致。
这个心愿已经由朋友点亮上链，链接不能再次使用。
代付链接已超过 24 小时有效期。请联系心愿作者重新生成。
付款和网络手续费都由你的钱包支付，需要你在钱包里确认签名。
代付需要用你自己的钱包登录（非托管账户），请切换为钱包登录。
请先连接你自己的钱包。
收款地址与官方配置不一致，已停止付款。
心愿已上链，作者会收到站内通知。谢谢你！
如果钱包已扣款，请保留交易链接并联系作者；资金只会进入官方收款地址。
这个代付链接已被使用
链上核验未通过：未找到符合要求的付款
en: Create a single-use payment link valid for 24 hours so a friend can pay from their own wallet
Friend pay works only for public standard wish cards (paid in SOL)
Send this link to a friend. It is valid until {time} and can be used once.
Your friend signs and pays from their own wallet; funds go straight to the official receiving address. Guangqi does not send transactions or hold funds. You stay the card's author.
This friend-pay link does not exist or has been removed.
Safety: only pay to the receiving address marked “Official” below. Never trust anyone who privately asks you to transfer to another address.
This is Guangqi's official receiving address, the same one listed on the Help page.
A friend has already lit this wish on-chain; the link cannot be used again.
This link is past its 24-hour validity. Ask the wish author to create a new one.
Your wallet pays both the amount and the network fee; you confirm the signature in your wallet.
Friend pay needs your own wallet (non-custodial). Please sign in with a wallet.
Please connect your own wallet first.
Confirm the signature in your wallet…
The receiving address does not match the official configuration; payment stopped.
The wish is on-chain and the author will get an inbox notice. Thank you!
If your wallet was charged, keep the transaction link and contact the author; funds only go to the official receiving address.
{name} paid to put your wish on-chain: {text}
This friend-pay link has already been used
On-chain verification failed: no matching payment found
